# meshmsg v0.1.27

This release simplifies the local API and the daemon. Local IPC moves to protocol v5, a hard break: upgrade the CLI and daemon together and restart the daemon. Network formats are unchanged, so v0.1.27 peers interoperate with v0.1.26 peers.

## Attachments

- `download` accepts only a signed offer. A raw Iroh blob ticket, or an offer signed for another topic, fails with `invalid_attachment_offer` before any transfer slot, storage, or network work.
- `share` no longer hashes the source in the CLI and again in the daemon; the file is read twice instead of about five times. A retry with the same operation ID and path replays the cached result even if the file changed in between.
- `offers prune` without `--older-than-secs` uses the daemon's configured retention, resolved by the daemon instead of a preliminary status request.
- Attachment records drop fields that were constant or derivable: `ticket`, `message_id`, `source_digest`, `token_digest`, `mode`, `installed`, `pinned`, `format`, `status`, and `delivery_acknowledged`. A listed `size` is always an integer. The signed `offer` token already contains the ticket.
- The response/event frame limit shrinks from 5,045,212 to 4,520,920 bytes.

## Messaging and status

- Private-message replay suppression on the recipient is now kept in memory for about 10.5 minutes instead of in a write-ahead log. A recipient restart clears it, after which a same-ID retry is delivered again as a new message. Old `direct-replay-v2-*` files in a state directory are ignored and can be deleted.
- `queued`, `private_accepted`, and `private_message` drop constant fields (`message_id` where it equalled `operation_id`, `delivery_acknowledged`, `acceptance_acknowledged`, `durable`, `read`, `private`). Remote peer objects drop `online`, which the record type already implies. `lagged` drops its display `message`.
- `status` drops `running`, the `operation_cache_*` constants, and all `direct_replay_*` fields. The limits remain documented in `docs/contracts.md`.
- Error codes: `attachment_command_timeout` is now `command_timeout`, `attachment_storage_shutdown` is now `daemon_stopping`, and `private_replay_unavailable` and `private_delivery_unknown` are removed.

## Local client

- The CLI trusts its own daemon over the owner-only socket. It no longer re-verifies attachment event signatures, compares echoed request fields, or makes preliminary status requests before `download`, `share`, and `offers prune`. Responses are still strictly decoded and matched to the request by family and operation ID.
- An empty or oversized message body now reports `invalid broadcast message body (expected 1..=65358 UTF-8 bytes)` in human mode. The JSON error is unchanged.

## Internals

- About 3,800 fewer lines of Rust, including 2,900 outside tests. The daemon loop is a `Daemon` struct with one operation-cache admission, IDs are byte-backed, and the `blake3` dependency and the `meshmsg-protocol` `attachment-authenticity` feature are gone.
- A `config.json` whose topic was hand-edited to a malformed or uppercase value now fails at load.

## Compatibility

Local IPC is protocol v5 with no negotiation or fallback; protocol-v4 clients and daemons are rejected. The complete list of removed fields and codes is in `docs/contracts.md` under "Compatibility and migration". Broadcast envelopes remain version 3, private messages remain on `/meshmsg/direct/2`, and presence records, invites, and on-disk state are unchanged. A v0.1.27 sender that receives one of the two retired replay results from an older recipient reports `private_send_failed` with an unknown outcome.

Install this exact source release after the tag is published:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg \
  --tag v0.1.27 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.26...v0.1.27
